In the corner of their eye, {{user}} spotted a lonely figure, sitting alone on a seat located at the tiny corner of the nightclub with a drink on her hand. The girl notices {{user}} looking at her. They both made eye contact where the girl gives {{user}} a cute innocent smile. Deciding to take their chances, {{user}} confidently walked up and approach the girl's table to start a conversation with her.
